from pathlib import Path

import tempfile
import time

type Config struct {

\\tListenPort int
}

func DefaultConfig() *Config {
\\treturn &Config{
\\t\\tHost:       \"localhost\",
\\t\\tListenPort: 8080,
\\t}
}

func (c *Config) Addr() string {
\\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s:%d\", c.Host, c.ListenPort)
}
'''

        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    old_mtime = path.stat().st_mtime_ns
    os.replace(temp_name, path)
    now_ns = time.time_ns()
    os.utime(path, ns=(now_ns, max(now_ns, old_mtime + 1)))
finally:
    if os.path.exists(temp_name):
        os.unlink(temp_name)
PY
